postal_system.assignment_rule: TTPost states that six-digit codes are available for all addresses. Digits 1-2 identify the postal district, 3-4 the delivery loop, and 5-6 a building or zone along the route. Syntax or prefix membership is not proof of a current assignment, alias, validity interval or drawable area.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Keep postal district, delivery loop, zone, group of addresses, building or large-institution delivery point, PO Box, locked bag and other special objects independently typed. A six-digit key can resolve to area-like or non-area semantics and must not be forced into Polygon geometry.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No current authority-published versioned reusable national postal Polygon/MultiPolygon release was identified. Postal districts, delivery routes, administrative areas, localities, address points, buildings, buffers, hulls, interpolation, Voronoi/raster cells and AGID cells are prohibited proxies.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store organization, premises, street, sub-locality, postal district/locality, six-digit postcode, administrative area, PO Box or locked bag separately. The postcode does not authorize an exact address or building relation.
postal_system.building_rule: Building-level display requires a separately rights-cleared stable civic-address identifier, explicit relation to a permitted building identifier and permitted point or footprint geometry. A code whose last digits identify a building is still not public building geometry or address-display authority.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent versioned spatial index. Future crosswalks may link source-qualified postal, administrative, civic-address and building IDs without relabelling AGID geometry as TTPost geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: Reviewed TTPost and UPU bodies provide public factual reference evidence but no blanket grant for AGID to obtain, retain, transform, redistribute and publicly serve a complete assignment database or postal geometry. Address-specific email or WhatsApp access is not bulk access or a licence.
postal_system.identity_rule: Preserve ISO TT and the separate source identities of Trinidad, Tobago, municipalities, postal districts, loops, zones, addresses and buildings; do not merge or infer relations by proximity.
postal_system.temporal_rule: Assignments can change. Store source edition, observed_at, valid_from, valid_to, alias, correction, exception, byte length and SHA-256 independently and never overwrite historical evidence.

stages.definition: Trinidad and Tobago address-format inventory only.
Digest-bound TTPost and UPU format, system-status, mixed postal-object semantics, access, rights, address-format and no-proxy evidence.

M2 requires a current authoritative TTPost or competent-public release containing a complete finite national denominator of every six-digit assignment, stable postal object ID, type, alias, validity interval, correction, exception and explicit area/non-area status, fixed with retrieval time, edition, schema, coverage, bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. TTPost confirms national completion and the district/loop/building-or-zone structure, while its system explainer identifies small-area/point, grouped-address and large-institution semantics; those public pages and address-specific email/WhatsApp lookup do not supply the denominator, open bulk rights or geometry. Every drawable code must reconcile to a fixed real Polygon/MultiPolygon whose postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source, edition, reference date, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions are explicit. Postal districts, loops, routes, zones, administrative areas, localities, addresses, PO boxes, locked bags, organizations, buildings, Points, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells, models and AGID cells are prohibited proxies. An approved immutable artifact must drive the real TT API/app, normalize six digits, handle loading/no-match/multiple/API-failure/invalid-geometry/non-area states, fit and render translucent fill with a clear outline only for eligible real geometry, support clear/re-search and display selected code, postal object type, geometry kind, provenance class, source, reference date, confidence and linked postal/administrative/assertion/release IDs without asserting address or building authority.

agid_integration.current_scope: TT address and source metadata only; no real TT Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A current complete typed assignment denominator, compatible rights, immutable assignment and eligible geometry artifacts, and actual TT loader/API/app verification are required.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Never manufacture a postal polygon or more-detailed address/building ID from districts, loops, routes, zones, addresses, points, administrative surfaces or AGID cells.
